parameters: \pop[384,100]Machiko's unique skill applies a buff automatically every turn.
\pop[384,100]"Transition" switches the buff that is applied.
\pop[384,100]"Ghetto Blaster" results in a powerful effect dependent
on which buff is currently being applied.
\pop[384,100]Yazawa's unique skill "Schwing!" causes equal damage to all enemy units.
\pop[384,100]Great in situations where there are many enemies
but when there is only one enemy the damage is lackluster.
\pop[384,100]Jackie's unique skill "10-Step Kill" allows her to evade all enemy attacks and deliver a devastating counter.
\pop[384,100]As with other instant skills, you can attack on the same turn but...
\pop[384,100]If you auto reload when trying to attack and receive an auto reload penalty
Jackie will fail to evade attacks and her counters will be ineffective.
When AP hits zero you will auto reload.
\pop[384,100]If this occurs your evasion will drop to zero
until the next turn and you will be vulnerable to enemy attacks.
\pop[384,100]You can reload manually before you run out of ammo by selecting reload
from the command list and use one turn to restore
your AP, to avoid leaving yourself vulnerable.
